snippet.title: LightBreak - Official Launch Trailer | Dames 4 Games Halloween Showcase 2025
snippet.description: LightBreak is available now on PC (via Steam and the Epic Games Store). Watch the LightBreak launch trailer for this cozy musical puzzle game where you create melodies, craft calming soundscapes, and guide Ava - a voiceless girl - as she uncovers mysterious hidden memories.
